sessionEnded.notice: You were signed out because your session ended, for example after an upgrade or restart. Sign in again to continue. API tokens are not affected.

appsList.title: Apps
appsList.emptyBody: Deploy from a git repository or a container image, or import apps from another platform.
appsList.noMatchBody: No app fits the current status and search. Clear the filters to see all {{total}}.
appsList.errorBody: The app list could not be loaded. {{message}}

deleteApp.title: Delete "{{name}}"?
deleteApp.description: This stops and removes the app's containers, then deletes the app. If its node is unreachable the app is still deleted and cleanup retries until it succeeds. This cannot be undone.
deleteApp.pendingDescription: Its containers are not removed yet ({{reason}}). Cleanup retries automatically.

cascadeDelete.label: Also delete everything inside
cascadeDelete.hint: Removes every app and database in it and their containers. Volumes are kept. If something cannot be removed, nothing else is lost and you can run this again.

loginHelp.lockedOut: Locked out? On the server, run

status.title: Platform status
status.healthy: Docker, disk, nodes and certificates look fine.

cliConsole.title: Console
cliConsole.description: Runs the CLI as you. Every command is audited.
cliConsole.pressEnter: Press Enter to connect. A fresh confirmation is required.
cliConsole.connected: Connected to {{server}}. Type help to list commands.
cliConsole.connectFailed: Could not connect, press Enter to try again
cliConsole.helpIntro: Available commands (Tab completes, help <command> lists subcommands):
cliConsole.helpLocal: Also: help, clear. Ctrl+C cancels a running command, Ctrl+L clears the screen.

quick.title: Quick actions
quick.connectFirst: Connect the console to see quick actions.

appRollback.label: Roll back app
appRollback.consequence: The app is pointed back at an older image and its container is replaced.

systemRestart.label: Restart platform
systemRestart.consequence: The control plane restarts and the dashboard is unavailable until it is back.

dock.offDescription: The CLI console is a beta feature and is off by default. An administrator can turn it on in Settings, Beta features.

dock.moveHint: Arrow keys move the dock, Shift for larger steps, Home resets its position.

ai.notConfiguredDescription: Add a BYOK API key in Settings to start chatting.
ai.experimentalOffDescription: AI chat is a beta feature and is off by default. An administrator can turn it on in Settings, Beta features, no server access needed.

login.setupHint: Create the first account for this instance. Registration is for the first account only.

controlPlaneRestart.title: Restart the control plane?
controlPlaneRestart.description: The dashboard and API go offline for a few seconds while the process restarts. Running apps and databases keep running.
controlPlaneRestart.consequence1: Open deploys and log streams are interrupted and resume afterwards.
controlPlaneRestart.consequence2: Connected nodes reconnect on their own.
controlPlaneRestart.unsupported: Automatic restart is unavailable here: nothing would relaunch the process.
controlPlaneRestart.stopping: Restarting: the control plane is shutting down...
controlPlaneRestart.waiting: Restarting: waiting for the control plane to come back...
controlPlaneRestart.back: The control plane is back online.
controlPlaneRestart.timeout: The control plane has not come back after two minutes. Check the service on the server.

signIn.subtitleSetup: Create the first account for this instance. Registration is for the first account only.

token.title: Revoke "{{name}}"?
token.consequence0: Anything using this token loses access immediately.

alertRule.title: Delete "{{name}}"?
alertRule.consequence0: The rule stops evaluating and notifying immediately.

backupTarget.title: Delete "{{name}}"?
backupTarget.consequence0: The connection to this bucket is removed.
backupTarget.consequence1: Nothing already backed up there is deleted.

networkShare.title: Delete "{{name}}"?
networkShare.consequence0: Any app volume still mounting this share fails to start on its next deploy.

registryCredential.title: Delete "{{name}}"?
registryCredential.consequence0: Any service referencing this credential fails to pull a private image on its next deploy.

model.title: Delete "{{name}}"?
model.consequence0: The engine container is removed and the API key stops working.
model.consequence1: Downloaded weights are kept, so deploying the same model again does not download them twice.

featureFlag.title: Delete "{{name}}"?
featureFlag.consequence1: Any app still calling the evaluate endpoint for it starts getting a 404.
